Container.Name: claudeclaw
Container.Overview: claudeclaw runs Claude Code as a persistent background daemon with Telegram, Discord, and Slack messaging bridges, scheduled cron jobs, voice transcription via Whisper, and a web dashboard. Requires a Claude Code subscription at claude.ai/code — no API key needed.
Container.Requires: A Claude Code subscription (claude.ai/code) is required. After starting the container for the first time, open a terminal to it and run: claude login
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: claude ai assistant llm telegram discord slack whisper voice cron jobs automation

Config.Name: Web Dashboard Port
Config.Description: Port for the claudeclaw web dashboard.

Config.Name: App Data
Config.Description: Stores Claude Code credentials, claudeclaw settings, logs, jobs, and Whisper models. Must persist across restarts.

Config.Name: Notes Directory
Config.Description: Optional host directory for claudeclaw to read. Reference it in prompts and jobs as /mnt/notes.

Config.Name: Documents Directory
Config.Description: Optional host directory for claudeclaw to read. Reference it in prompts and jobs as /mnt/documents.

Config.Name: Backup Directory
Config.Description: Optional host directory for backups. Run /backup.sh inside the container to create a timestamped snapshot of all claudeclaw data here.

Container.Description:
claudeclaw extends Claude Code into a personal AI assistant daemon that runs continuously in the background.
AUTHENTICATION — REQUIRED BEFORE USE: claudeclaw uses your Claude Code subscription, not an API key. After starting the container for the first time, open a terminal to the container in Unraid and run: claude login
This opens an OAuth browser flow. Complete it once and your credentials are saved to the app data directory. They persist across container restarts.
CONFIGURATION: On first start, a default settings.json is created at your app data path under claudeclaw/settings.json. Edit this file to configure messaging bridges, heartbeat intervals, security levels, and session options. A full example with all available fields is at https://github.com/paulmeier/claudeclaw-container/blob/main/settings.example.json
MESSAGING SETUP: Telegram — add your BotFather token and allowed user IDs to settings.json. Discord — add your bot token, enable Message Content Intent in the developer portal, and add channel IDs. Slack — add your xoxb- bot token and xapp- app-level token (Socket Mode required). All messaging bridges use outbound connections only — no additional ports need to be opened.
ADDITIONAL DIRECTORIES: Mount host directories under /mnt/ to give claudeclaw access to your files. Use read-only mode for directories it should only read, read-write for those it can modify.
BACKUPS: Mount a backup directory and run /backup.sh inside the container to create a timestamped snapshot.
